DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with right-sided heart failure (cor pulmonale).

Given your heavy smoking history, two months of dry cough and exertional dyspnea, recent wheezing, and new ankle swelling, it is highly likely you have developed COPD complicated by cor pulmonale due to pulmonary hypertension. I recommend requesting a Chest_X-Ray and an Echocardiogram to confirm these findings.
